env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.label: Auth secret, min 32 chars — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

env.name: WEB_URL
env.label: Public URL the portal is served from — email invite and reset links are built from this

env.name: API_URL
env.label: Public API URL — same value, the image serves app and API from one origin

env.name: SECURE_COOKIES
env.label: Secure cookies — set to false when serving over plain HTTP

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: External PostgreSQL URL (optional, blank uses the built-in database)

env.name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
env.label: Storage provider: local, s3, minio or r2

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.label: Resend API key (optional, enables invite and reset emails)

env.name: CASHPILOT_SECRET_KEY
env.label: Encryption key — blank to auto-generate (set a fixed value to keep stored credentials across redeploys)

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone, e.g. Europe/London (used for logs and time widgets)

env.name: HOST
env.label: Public domain (e.g. sign.example.com) — used for links and emails

env.name: GTS_HOST
env.label: Your public domain (cannot be changed later)

env.name: GTS_DB_ADDRESS
env.label: SQLite database file (kept on the storage volume)

env.name: GTS_LETSENCRYPT_ENABLED
env.label: Use built-in Let's Encrypt (set false when behind a reverse proxy)

env.name: HOST
env.label: Bind address — keep 0.0.0.0 so the port mapping is reachable

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: External URL for links and webhooks

env.name: AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE
env.label: Reached over plain HTTP, with no HTTPS in front
